from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0029.png'))

for c in range(230, 290):
    for r in range(410, 350, -1):
        if img[r, c, 0] > 100 and img[r, c, 1] < 100 and img[r, c, 2] < 50:
            pot_rows.append((c, r))
            break

print('Pot bottom points in obs_0029:', len(pot_rows))
max_r = max(p[1] for p in pot_rows)
print('Max row:', max_r)
for p in pot_rows:
    if p[1] == max_r:
        print('Bottom pt:', p)
"
